en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a group of traditionally dressed men standing in front of a gigantic fallen ancient statue among palm trees. The statue appears to be a large recumbent pharaonic colossus lying on its back. Handwritten ink messages are visible across the bottom. Printed text at the lower left mentions 'Kharkioche F., Alexandrie., Droit réservé.' and at the bottom right 'Photographie ... Co'.
